method.editor: the real `vpng ui` program, driven over HTTP
method.client: the standard library's urllib; no third-party package
method.checker: an independent reader of the container, written from the specification rather than from the project's own decoder
method.viewport: the top-left 512x512 rectangle, or the whole picture when it is smaller
method.scope: the timings are the wall clock of one HTTP round trip on this host; they are not a performance claim and they include the Python client
